_comment: Ceilings for everything a session loads BEFORE it does any work, in tokens
(rough: words x 1.3, tools/build_views.py:_approx_tokens). One registry so
no cap is declared twice -- registry-source-of-truth. Practice:
A ceiling is a watermark, not an endorsement: each was set at the measured
size when the surface was last reviewed, rounded up for headroom, so it can
be ratcheted DOWN by a reduction pass and never drifts up unnoticed. Raising
one is a decision somebody makes on purpose, in a commit, with the reason in
'why'. Never raise it to make a red check green.
_headroom_comment: When a surface gets within this % of its ceiling, the merge and push gates
say so -- tools/session_load_trend.py's headroom_notice(), called from
tools/precedent_gate.py. It is a NOTICE and never a failure.
WHY it exists: the ceiling check is binary -- green at 11,999 tokens and red
at 12,001 -- so it reports the wall only once a session has already hit it.
On 2026-09-13/14 that happened four times in two days, each time to a
session that had come to do something else and now owed a reduction pass
before it could push. 'Green' carried no information anybody could plan
against. This says the DISTANCE instead.
5% of 12,000 is 600 tokens. At the occasion index's own measured growth
(+232/day over 2026-09-11..14) that is a few days of warning rather than
none. It is a notice threshold, not a target: headroom is the distance to
the next forced reduction pass, never room to spend.
_occasion_index_comment: Cap on the GENERATED occasion index inside the loader block, enforced by
been capped since phase 2; this half never was.
WHY: measured 2026-09-14, the index had grown every single day -- 1,136
tokens on 08-31, 2,753 on 09-11, 3,377 on 09-14, about 160 a day over the
fortnight. That is 29% of AGENTS.md accruing with nobody deciding it, and
no reduction pass can touch a token of it. Four times in two days the file
crossed its ceiling and a session trimmed PROSE to make room for generated
text it was not allowed to trim.
Set at 3,600 against 3,377 measured: ~220 tokens, which is about one more
day of growth at the observed rate. Deliberately tight. The cap is meant to
be met soon and often, because meeting it is the decision it exists to
force -- does this practice earn a line every session pays for, or does it
want a real applies_to glob or a gate instead?
Morgan chose this on 2026-09-14 from a costed menu (option D), strength:
decided. Raising it is his call, with the reason recorded here.
_occasion_index_fallback_comment: RISK INPUT, not a decision (practice: constants-are-risk-inputs). The 3,600
above binds THIS repository. This registry is not vendored, so a consumer
with no occasion_index_tokens of its own is capped by the literal fallback
in tools/build_views.py, 4,000, which nobody decided: it landed in the same
commit as the 3,600 (826f6e3c) with no reason recorded, and it caps every
source a consumer resolves together, not one catalogue. All four practice
sets ran on it as of 2026-09-26. Value left unchanged; the question is
waiting on Morgan. Leaves this register only by his dated decision.

AGENTS.md.why: Set at 19000 against a tree 14 commits stale, then re-measured on the merged tree at 19687 -- the growth is one freshness-guard gotcha added upstream the same day. Raised once, after the review the rule asks for rather than instead of it: the gotchas section is 10,494 of the total, and every entry very_deep_check.py flagged as claiming its own trap settled was read and still bites, so nothing was archived. The next raise should come with a reduction pass, not another re-measurement. 2026-09-11, later the same day: adding generated-edit-goes-upstream put the file at 20,048 and the ceiling was NOT raised. The reduction pass the clause asks for found one entry whose central claim had gone false -- the timezone-diagnosis entry called settings.local.json's env block inert, which the commit-identity entry beside it contradicts from a same-day measurement -- and moved it to record/GOTCHAS_ARCHIVE.md entry 31 in full. Measured 19,922 after. 2026-09-11, later still: the clean-session practice took the file to 20,235 and the ceiling was again NOT raised. The reduction pass compressed the verify_harness fixture-credential entry -- three variables, all three now scrubbed at the head of the harness and held there by a control, so only a NEW variable can bite -- to record/GOTCHAS_ARCHIVE.md entry 32 in full, keeping the symptom, the way to tell inheritance from absence, and the generalization live. Measured 19,753 after. 2026-09-13: spawn-session's wake-first amendment took the file over at 20,124 and the ceiling was again NOT raised. Two reductions, in order: the new paragraph itself was cut to its claim, dropping the origin story that the practice's own Story already holds in full; then the git-clone-without---branch gotcha was compressed to the symptom, the lesson and the pin. That one was already archived as record/GOTCHAS_ARCHIVE.md entry 36, whose own verdict says the live entry should keep the incident short and the lesson in full -- it had never actually been shortened, so this pass did what the archive already claimed. Measured 19,986 after. 2026-09-13, later: one quick-index row for spec/SOURCE_SET_PROSE_GAP.md took the file to 20,040 and the ceiling was again NOT raised. The reduction pass compressed the declared-hooks-exist gotcha -- its wrong-inference symptom kept, its story dropped to record/GOTCHAS_ARCHIVE.md entry 37, where it already sat in full -- on the ground that BOTH halves are mechanical now, so a session meets this as a failing check rather than as a reading it has to get right unaided. Measured 19935 after. 2026-09-13, a reduction pass run against the whole always-loaded surface rather than against one added practice: measured 19,986 here, plus 2,863 of .precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md and 55 of CLAUDE.md, for 22,904 tokens before any work starts against a hard target of 20,000. Three duplications came out, each verified present in full somewhere a session already reads: the eight Precedent commands' coining stories (729 tokens -- every one of them is in its own practice file's ## Story, which the standing instruction and the occasion index both route to), three convention bullets restating reply-links-files, doc-references-are-links and volatile-rules-carry-dates (174 -- the first is in the resident block verbatim, the other two in the occasion index), and the duplicated halves of the private-source bootstrap block (93). The environment-naming trap in the credential gotcha moved to INSTALL.md section 8's environment table, where somebody setting the variables reads it (100). Measured 18,890 after, so the ceiling is ratcheted DOWN from 20,000 to 19,000 rather than left as headroom. What this pass did NOT do: the gotchas section is 8,963 of the 18,890 across 36 entries, tools/very_deep_check.py's currency pass flags none of them as stale, and 26 of the 36 were already shortened by an earlier pass that decided what the live half should keep -- so cutting further there is a judgment call and went to Morgan costed rather than being taken here. Re-measured 18,868 after merging both: this pass and the declared-hooks-exist compression above landed in the same hour, on top of a quick-index row and go-merge's new blocked-step-hands-off clause, which the resident command list carries too. 2026-09-13, later still: a ninth command (`vocabulary`), the `Approved` trigger on go-merge and the seeded merge authorization on spawn-session arrived on top of that ratchet -- about 270 tokens against 132 of headroom -- and the 19,000 ceiling was NOT raised back. The reduction came out of the same command list the pass above had just written: every new clause was cut to its rule, and four glosses that restate their own practice's Why rather than its Rule went with them (three-things' attention-rather-than-action reasoning, park-it's explanation of why no explanation is owed, spawn-session's answer-back argument, my-options' contrast with Plain words). A quick-index row for the vocabulary tool was dropped as duplicating the command list's own entry. Measured 18,994 after. 2026-09-13, the split: Morgan chose 'bolded lead only' from a costed menu, so the gotchas section became an INDEX -- one line per trap, the symptom and a link -- and all 36 entries moved to record/GOTCHAS.md in full. Verified word for word: 6,778 words out of the section, 6,778 into the record, identical. 8,858 tokens of section became 1,462 of index. Measured 11,468 after merging the base branch back in (which had added a ninth command meanwhile), with .precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md at 2,863 and CLAUDE.md at 55: 14,386 before any work starts, against the 20,000 target. Ceiling ratcheted 19,000 -> 12,000. The guarantee moved with the text rather than being dropped: precedent_check.py's environment-gotchas follows the links and applies the same story test to the record (five stated cases in verify_harness.py), and very_deep_check.py's currency pass reads the record's bodies, so it still sees 36 entries and 9,473 tokens rather than going quietly blind on one-line symptoms. 2026-09-14, the standing question answered: Morgan picked options B, C and D together from the costed menu in TODO.md's agents-md-ceiling-policy item -- "I think we should do B, C, and D. now" -- strength: decided. C was the split: the quick index had grown to 88 rows and 2,671 tokens, and the full table moved to WHERE_THINGS_ARE.md with the dozen rows sessions reach for constantly left inline (the quick-index check needs five, and the practice asks for the rows sessions actually hunt for, so the short table satisfies both). No row was dropped; 11,590 -> 9,336. D was the cap: occasion_index_tokens above, the first budget the generated half has ever had. B is the part that did NOT come out as expected, and the number is unchanged at 12,000 rather than raised. Raising it was costed as buying days rather than months -- at the index's measured growth, 14,000 bought 10-15 days and 20,000 bought 36-53 -- and C then reclaimed 2,254 tokens, taking headroom from 3.4% to 22.2%, so there was no pressure left for a raise to relieve. What B actually asked for was a number chosen on purpose instead of a ratchet artifact, and that is what it now is: 12,000 = 5,600 (the resident cap of 2,000 plus the occasion cap of 3,600, which is the most the generated half can ever be) + 6,400 declared allowance for hand-written prose, which is 4,996 today. The structural guarantee that buys, and the reason this number is safe to hold: if the generated half filled to both caps the file would reach 10,596, so generated growth ALONE can no longer put it over. Every future crossing is now prose somebody chose to write, which is visible, attributable and trimmable -- which is exactly what the four crossings on 09-13/14 were not. Raising this above 12,000 stays Morgan's call; nothing here needs it. 2026-09-16: the split from 09-13 had already moved every story out of the section, but the ONE-LINE INDEX it left behind -- symptom plus link, one per trap -- was still loaded whole, every session, growing without a ceiling of its own; it reached 1,736 tokens (44 entries) before anyone measured what it cost at the top of every conversation. The index moved out too: gotchas/*.md (the 2026-09-16 todo/gotcha migration's own per-file format) is now the only place any of it lives, a generated gotchas/INDEX.md (tools/build_gotcha_index.py) holds the same one-line-per-live-entry overview for the deliberate read, and the section here is a six-line pointer -- grep gotchas/ by symptom before concluding a failure is new, per practice: grep-before-search. Verified same as the 09-13 split: precedent_check.py's environment-gotchas now reads gotchas/*.md directly and applies the same story test to every status: live entry (still five stated cases, rewritten in verify_harness.py to plant a bare-fix gotcha file rather than an AGENTS.md bullet); very_deep_check.py's currency pass reads the same files, rerooting their relative links the way it already did for a linked record, so it still sees all 44 entries rather than going blind on a pointer with nothing to parse. Section: 1,736 -> 222 tokens. Whole file: 7,930 -> 6,445 (the difference includes the resident block's own +23 tokens, from environment-gotchas.md's Rule text describing the new shape). Ceiling left at 12,000 -- headroom is now large enough that a ratchet down is Morgan's call to make, not a session's to impose.

CLAUDE.md.why: An @AGENTS.md include. Anything more than a line or two here is content that belongs in the file it includes.

.precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md.why: Generated at session start from the team and individual sources, so it varies with what resolved; the ceiling is the whole of what those sources may add to every session here.
